name: phase
description: A wave of the programme — a band of work sharing an intent, holding the units that carry it out.

aiGuidance.purpose: The top structural level of the programme. A phase names one of the four waves and says what that wave is for; the units doing the work hang beneath it.
aiGuidance.extraction: Create a phase when the source describes a band of work by its intent rather than by a specific task. There are four; do not invent a fifth.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: A phase is not a milestone or a date range — if the source is about when something happens rather than what kind of work it is, it is not a phase.
